name: migration
description: Plan a mechanical migration, apply it to three slices of the codebase in parallel, build and test, then review.

stages.name: Plan
stages.promptTemplate:
Migration: {task}

List the transformation rules and split the affected folders into three roughly equal slices.

stages.name: Batch 1
stages.promptTemplate:
Apply the migration to slice 1 of the plan only. Task: {task}

{input:plan}

stages.name: Batch 2
stages.promptTemplate:
Apply the migration to slice 2 of the plan only. Task: {task}

{input:plan}

stages.name: Batch 3
stages.promptTemplate:
Apply the migration to slice 3 of the plan only. Task: {task}

{input:plan}

stages.name: Build & test
stages.promptTemplate:
Build the whole solution and run all tests after the migration: {task}

Report every failure with the file it comes from.

stages.name: Review
stages.promptTemplate:
Review the migration for: {task}

Check that all slices were treated the same way and nothing was missed.
